turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
What went through your mind then?
I work as a project manager at a logistics company and I have been completely burned out since October.
And how was that for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. It is not easy to talk about.
What happened next?
My father was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn, and I am the one who drives him to the hospital in Leeds.
Take your time.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. It is not easy to talk about.
How did that feel for you?
My younger sister Hannah lives in Toronto, so all the care for our father falls on me.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
How did that feel for you?
Most nights I sleep about four hours, I wake up at three in the morning and cannot fall back asleep.
How did that feel for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. That is how it was.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
